input: Set up a dedicated creative studio space in the spare room

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Creative Studio in the Spare Room
gold.taskDescription: Transform the spare room into a dedicated creative studio space tailored to the user's specific creative work and needs.

questions.title: What creative activities will this studio primarily support?
questions.description: Identify the main creative discipline (e.g., painting, music, photography, writing, crafts) to shape the entire setup.

questions.title: What is the current state of the spare room?
questions.description: Understand whether the room is empty, used for storage, or already partially furnished so planning can account for clearing or repurposing.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this project?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to guide decisions on furniture, equipment, storage, and decor.

questions.title: Do you need to buy new furniture or use what you have?
questions.description: Determine whether the plan involves sourcing new pieces, repurposing existing items, or a mix of both.

questions.title: Are there any structural changes you are willing to make?
questions.description: Find out if the user is open to painting walls, adding shelving, improving lighting fixtures, or other semi-permanent modifications.

questions.title: Will anyone else share or use this studio space?
questions.description: Clarify whether the space is solely for the user or needs to accommodate collaborators, students, or family members.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having the studio ready?
questions.description: Establish a target completion date to prioritize tasks and set a realistic pace for the project.
